'Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei naru Musouroku' Reveals Additional Cast, First Promo
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Umikaze Minamino's Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei naru Musouroku (Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden) light novel revealed additional additional cast, a key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video on Tuesday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 6 at 9:25 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS Nippon TV and MBS. The series will hold a special stage event a...
